description.subtitle: Puma Borussia Dortmund Soccer Ball 2025 2026 Size 5 - Silver
description.intro: The Puma Borusia Dortmund Culture Size 5 Ball combines club identity and functional performance in an official design. Thanks to its machine sewing with a rubber chamber, it is ideal for your training sessions or matches with friends.
key_benefits: Club pride: Official Borussia design to show off your colors.
Sturdy Construction: Machine stitched with rubber chamber ensuring stable shape and long-lasting use.
Good control: Textured material for greater precision in passing and shooting.
Adapted to your age: Size 5: Standard for competitions and players from 12 years old.
Perfect for training: Designed to improve technique and consistency.
